name: ASI Cafeteria, Nalanda Ruins
why_it_matters: The small canteen on the Archaeological Survey of India site at the Nalanda Ruins — limited menu of snacks, tea and bottled water. Practical rather than scenic; the only food option inside the protected zone.
insider_tip: Open during ruin visiting hours (9am-5pm). For a full meal, head 11 km to Rajgir or 9 km to Bihar Sharif — Nalanda village itself has only roadside dhabas.

name: Highway Dhaba, Nalanda-Rajgir Road
area: Nalanda-Rajgir Main Road, opposite ruins entrance
why_it_matters: The cluster of small dhabas on the Nalanda-Rajgir road opposite the ruins entrance — about 3 km from the protected site. Sattu paratha, litti chokha and a working tea-stall format; the default lunch stop for tour buses.
insider_tip: Multiple competing carts — pick one with steam visibly rising from the litti coals. Cash only at most stalls; the chai is fresher than the food after the lunch rush.
signature_address: Nalanda-Rajgir Main Road, opposite Nalanda Ruins entrance, Nalanda 803111
